title: Unified Recruitment Pipeline Optimization
business: Talent acquisition teams managing high-volume candidate pipelines across disparate platforms.
problem: Recruiters suffer from context switching fatigue, manually toggling between Greenhouse for candidate data, Slack for team communication, and Google Calendar for interview scheduling, leading to delayed candidate responses.
solution: By integrating Greenhouse, Slack, and Google Calendar connectors into the Claude platform, recruiters create a centralized interface where Claude retrieves candidate profiles, drafts Slack updates for hiring managers, and proposes interview slots based on calendar availability.
steps: Authenticate the Greenhouse connector to allow Claude to query candidate application status and scorecards.
Enable the Slack connector to permit Claude to post interview summaries and candidate feedback to specific hiring channels.
Connect the Google Calendar integration to provide Claude with read-write access for scheduling coordination.
Prompt Claude to synthesize candidate data from Greenhouse and draft a Slack message to the hiring team with proposed interview times.
outcome: A streamlined, single-interface workflow that reduces manual data entry and accelerates the time-to-hire by consolidating fragmented communication and scheduling tasks.
limitation: The primary limitation is the dependency on connector-specific API rate limits and permissions; users must verify the scope of data access in the connector settings to ensure Claude has sufficient authorization to perform cross-tool actions.
